topics.name: AI agents
topics.signal: Software is moving from answering questions toward taking multi-step actions across tools and systems.
topics.whyItMatters: Agency changes the risk surface: the important question becomes not only what a model says, but what it can do without continuous human intervention.
topics.guardrail: Agentic capability is not evidence of consciousness, personhood or prophetic fulfillment.

topics.name: AI attachment & companions
topics.signal: Conversational systems can become persistent, personalized sources of reassurance, affirmation and simulated relationship.
topics.whyItMatters: The competition can move from attention toward attachment: what a person turns toward for comfort, identity, counsel and belonging.
topics.guardrail: Not every user becomes attached and not every LLM product is designed as a companion.

topics.name: Wearables, surveillance & ambient AI
topics.signal: Cameras, microphones and inference are moving into always-on wearable and public environments.
topics.whyItMatters: The boundary between seeing and recording becomes harder to notice, and institutional visibility can become continuous.
topics.guardrail: Surveillance capability alone does not map cleanly onto a specific apocalyptic symbol.

topics.name: Digital identity, money & access
topics.signal: Identity, payment and settlement infrastructure is becoming more programmable and digitally mediated.
topics.whyItMatters: When identity and commerce become tightly coupled to digital infrastructure, governance and exclusion rules matter more.
topics.guardrail: A CBDC, blockchain rail or digital ID is not therefore the 'mark of the beast.'

topics.name: Robotics & embodied autonomy
topics.signal: AI is moving from text and software into machines operating in physical environments.
topics.whyItMatters: Embodied autonomy changes labor, logistics, security and the meaning of machine action in shared physical spaces.
topics.guardrail: A humanoid form is an interface choice, not evidence of life or spirit.

topics.name: Autonomous weapons & defense AI
topics.signal: Militaries are deploying more autonomous sensing, interception and decision-support systems.
topics.whyItMatters: Speed can compress the time available for human judgment while diffusing accountability across operators, software and institutions.
topics.guardrail: Wars and weapons have accompanied many eras; new autonomy does not establish a unique prophetic timetable.

topics.name: AI + biotechnology
topics.signal: AI models are increasingly participating in biological discovery and experimental design.
topics.whyItMatters: The same acceleration that helps medicine can lower barriers to manipulating biological systems.
topics.guardrail: Scientific discovery should be evaluated on evidence and governance, not theological resemblance alone.

topics.name: Compute, energy & infrastructure
topics.signal: Frontier AI increasingly depends on enormous physical infrastructure: semiconductors, data centers, cooling, transmission and energy.
topics.whyItMatters: What looks like software at the interface is also a concentration of capital, energy and supply-chain power.
topics.guardrail: Infrastructure concentration is a political-economic fact, not a prophetic identity.

topics.name: Synthetic media & reality verification
topics.signal: Text, voice, image and video can increasingly be generated at low cost and high realism.
topics.whyItMatters: When evidence can be fabricated cheaply, verification and trusted provenance become core civic and personal skills.
topics.guardrail: Generated media is not supernatural deception; it is a technical challenge to evidence and trust.

topics.name: Space, satellites & planetary infrastructure
topics.signal: Launch costs, satellite networks and private space infrastructure continue to expand the technological operating environment.
topics.whyItMatters: Communication, surveillance, navigation and economic infrastructure increasingly extend beyond terrestrial networks.
topics.guardrail: Technological reach should not be confused with transcendence.
